These renderer sources are copied unchanged from PlayStunts commit b5180b0a54193974c3b398ec38e6680db99f67cf (https://github.com/ACatWithEbola/playstunts). GPL-3.0-only; see ../../LICENSE. overview-entry.ts selects the two public functions used by the editor. To regenerate src/native-overview.js, install esbuild 0.28.1 locally and run node scripts/build-overview-renderer.mjs. Normal editor builds use the checked-in renderer and need no dependencies.
